messages:
rachel: quick design QA: compact export modal + annotations. dropped figs: https://www.figma.com/file/compact-export (modal, annotations, keyboard) sam: nice. two quick things: export labels unclear (CSV vs JSON) and the "include annotations" toggle has no aria-label for screen readers. nines: accessibility: annotation count badges read visually but not announced. add visually-hidden text '3 annotations' and ensure badge contrast >= AA at 12px. bryan: dev note: large exports should queue async and show toast with link; don't block UI. also include export_reason for audit compliance. design-bot: automated scan: missing aria-label on toggle, contrast fail on badge, no focus-visible on modal close button. See /reports/scan-1866347890.pdf rachel: copy suggestion for modal header: 'Export diffs'. option labels: 'CSV (rows, compact annotations)' and 'JSON (full run payload)'. CTA: primary 'Queue export', secondary 'Cancel'. sam: keyboard: add shortcut 'E' to open export when focus is on run header; ensure roving tabindex inside modal for format options. default selection = CSV. nines: aria-live suggestion for export queue:
Export queued you'll receive an email when ready.
bryan: filing follow-ups: #UX-4601 export copy, #A11Y-234 badges + aria, #FE-745 async export endpoint. I'll update API schema to accept export_reason. rachel: thanks. I'll update Figma copy and add annotations for badges + keyboard hints. tagging eng-frontend for implementation next sprint. :thumbsup:
